'''1999 GenCon Open Nathan Reisch DS''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Nathan Reisch]]
* '''Event:''' [[1999 GenCon Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor HD Reisch DS 1999 GenCon.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Nathan triumphed over the largest field ever (152 players) and won 8 of 9 games (including an extra game forced by a true tie in his championship games against runner-up Joe Mornout). Here's his Dark Side deck. See how it played in the championship round - read Juz Pakes' play by play commentary of the '99 GenCon Open marathon.
